title: The bird at Last Bell
logline: The school steps at 3:05 with the bell drawn and the students pouring past, and the bird on the handrail, unmoved, in the crowd's wake. One girl looks. The page doesn't say what she sees.

panels.composition: The school's front steps at the last bell with students pouring down them past the small rainbow bird perched on the metal handrail, one girl turned back looking at it, a jagged bell shape at the door.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, school front steps at the last bell with students pouring past a small rainbow bird perched on the metal handrail and one girl turned back to look at it, a jagged sound shape at the door, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
